generation.scope: For every regular finite limit on the fifteen-dimensional component the entire kernel of reduction to the relative trace order is a nilpotent ideal. A residual non-domain regular point necessarily has a central nilpotent in path degree four or eight. Injectivity of the two low central trace evaluations on the single reduced representation scheme of dimension (4,4,4,4) guarantees that the 84-degree test decides regularity.

open_mathematics: Analyze these low-degree trace kernels using the quadratic quiver equations and the geometry of smaller simple families; continue identification of remaining finite components.
